# Operations

Every capability, as it appears on HTTP, MCP and the CLI.

## `add_robot`

Add the robot at an IP address, for when discovery can't reach it. The robot must answer there. Next, give it a password with `retrieve_password`.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `POST /v1/robots` |
| MCP | tool `add_robot` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit robots add [OPTIONS] ADDRESS` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | str | yes |  | The robot's IP address |

**Result**

Type: `DiscoveredRobot`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | str | yes |  |
| `name` | str | yes |  |
| `sku` | str | yes |  |
| `firmware` | str | yes |  |
| `address` | str | yes |  |
| `supported` | bool | yes |  |
| `profile_id` | str \| None | no |  |
| `configured` | bool | no |  |

## `clean_rooms`

Clean only the given rooms, in order, by name or ID. Refused with `map_changed` when the names come from an older map version, and with `room_not_found` (listing the valid rooms) when a room isn't on the current map. Confirmed when the robot reports cleaning.
Supported on: braava_m6, roomba_i5
Verification: braava_m6: unverified, roomba_i5: verified
⚠ Moves the robot: it will physically start, stop or drive.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `POST /v1/robots/{robot}/commands/clean_rooms` |
| MCP | tool `clean_rooms` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit rooms clean [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or unambiguous name |
| `rooms` | list[str] | yes |  | Rooms to clean, by name or ID, in the order to clean them. Must not be empty (the robot would clean the whole home). |
| `ordered` | bool | no | true | Clean in the given order; false lets the robot choose. |
| `room_options` | dict[str, RoomOptions] \| None | no | null | Per-room options keyed by an entry of `rooms`, e.g. {"Office": {"passes": "two"}}. On the CLI, pass it as JSON. |

**Result**

Type: `CommandResult`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `robot_id` | str | yes |  |
| `command` | str | yes |  |
| `outcome` | "confirmed" \| "unconfirmed" | yes |  |
| `state` | StateSummary | yes |  |
| `waited_ms` | int | yes |  |

## `cloud_history`

The robot's recent missions as the iRobot cloud recorded them (it keeps about 30), newest first. A running mission appears only minutes after the robot docks. While the cloud is unavailable, the last copy fetched is returned.
Supported on: braava_m6, roomba_i5
Verification: braava_m6: verified, roomba_i5: verified

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/robots/{robot}/cloud-history` |
| MCP | tool `cloud_history` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit cloud history [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or name |
| `limit` | int | no | 30 | Most recent missions to return |

**Result**

Type: `list[CloudMission]`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mission_ref` | str | yes | Cloud mission ID; equals the robot's mission ID |
| `robot_id` | str | yes |  |
| `number` | int \| None | no | The robot's mission counter |
| `started_at` | datetime \| None | no |  |
| `ended_at` | datetime \| None | no |  |
| `duration_s` | int \| None | no |  |
| `outcome` | MissionOutcome | yes |  |
| `initiator` | Initiator | yes |  |
| `area_m2` | float \| None | no |  |
| `rooms_requested` | list[str] | no | Empty = whole home |
| `evacs` | int \| None | no | Clean Base bin emptyings during the mission |
| `map` | MapRef \| None | no | The mission's map, used to fetch its coverage |
| `retrieved_at` | datetime | yes |  |

## `cloud_login`

Add or change the iRobot account login. It's checked by logging in and saved only if that works. Optional: it adds room names, floor plans, cloud history, coverage, the live mission timeline and password retrieval; local control never needs it.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `POST /v1/cloud_login` |
| MCP | not on MCP |
| CLI | `roomba-kit cloud login [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | str | yes |  | iRobot account email |
| `password` | str | yes |  | iRobot account password. The CLI prompts for it; it is never echoed, returned or logged. |
| `country` | str | no | "US" | The account's country code, e.g. US, GB, DE |

**Result**

Type: `CloudLoginResult`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | "connected" \| "failed" | yes |  |
| `reason` | str \| None | no | Why it failed: `auth_failed`, `timeout`, `connection_failed`, … |

## `cloud_logout`

Remove the stored iRobot account login and disconnect from the cloud. Credentials supplied by environment variables still apply.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `POST /v1/cloud_logout` |
| MCP | tool `cloud_logout` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit cloud logout [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

_No fields._

**Result**

Type: `CloudStatus`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | "connected" \| "unavailable" \| "not_configured" | yes |  |
| `reason` | str \| None | no |  |
| `last_ok` | datetime \| None | no |  |

## `cloud_retrieve_password`

Fetch a robot's local password from the iRobot account, check it by connecting, and store it. For models or robots that won't release it locally. The password is never returned.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `POST /v1/robots/{robot}/password/cloud` |
| MCP | tool `cloud_retrieve_password` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit cloud password [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or unambiguous name |

**Result**

Type: `CloudPasswordResult`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | "stored" \| "unavailable" | yes |  |
| `reason` | str \| None | no | Why not: a cloud status reason, `not_in_account`, or `auth_failed` when the robot rejected the password the account gave |

## `discover_robots`

Find iRobot robots on the local network: ID, name, SKU, firmware, address, whether the model is supported, and whether it's already configured.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/discover_robots` |
| MCP | tool `discover_robots` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit discover [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `broadcast` | str \| None | no | null | Where to send the discovery datagram: your subnet's broadcast address (e.g. 192.0.2.255) when a VPN owns the default route, or one robot's IP. Default: `[discovery] broadcast` in config.toml |
| `timeout_s` | float | no | 8.0 | How long to listen |

**Result**

Type: `list[DiscoveredRobot]`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | str | yes |  |
| `name` | str | yes |  |
| `sku` | str | yes |  |
| `firmware` | str | yes |  |
| `address` | str | yes |  |
| `supported` | bool | yes |  |
| `profile_id` | str \| None | no |  |
| `configured` | bool | no |  |

## `events_list`

List recorded events, oldest first, after `since`. Over HTTP, send `Accept: text/event-stream` to get the same events as a live SSE stream that resumes with `Last-Event-ID`.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/events` |
| MCP | tool `events_list` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit events list [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | int \| None | no | null | Return events with a seq greater than this; omit for the oldest |
| `robot` | str \| None | no | null | Only this robot (ID or unambiguous name) |
| `types` | list[EventType] \| None | no | null | Only these event types |
| `limit` | int | no | 100 | Most events to return |

**Result**

Type: `EventPage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events` | list[Event] | yes |  |
| `next` | int | yes | Pass as `since` to continue after these events |

## `events_wait`

Wait for events after `since` and return them as soon as any arrive, or an empty list at the timeout. Call again with `next` to keep following.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/events/wait` |
| MCP | tool `events_wait` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit events wait [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | int | yes |  | Wait for events with a seq greater than this |
| `robot` | str \| None | no | null | Only this robot (ID or unambiguous name) |
| `types` | list[EventType] \| None | no | null | Only these event types |
| `timeout_s` | float | no | 30 | Seconds to wait before returning no events |

**Result**

Type: `EventPage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events` | list[Event] | yes |  |
| `next` | int | yes | Pass as `since` to continue after these events |

## `get_coverage`

Where a finished mission cleaned: covered points, dirt detections and clutter, in metres from the dock. The cloud publishes it minutes after the robot docks; until then this returns `cloud_unavailable` with reason `not_yet_published`. Clutter is given as the vertices of each clutter area's outline.
Supported on: braava_m6, roomba_i5
Verification: braava_m6: verified, roomba_i5: verified

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/robots/{robot}/missions/{mission_id}/coverage` |
| MCP | tool `get_coverage` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit coverage [OPTIONS] ROBOT MISSION_ID` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or name |
| `mission_id` | str | yes |  | The kit mission ID (the robot's own mission ID) or the cloud mission ref |

**Result**

Type: `CoverageRecord`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `robot_id` | str | yes |  |
| `mission_ref` | str | yes |  |
| `map_id` | str | yes |  |
| `map_version` | str | yes |  |
| `points` | list[list[any]] | yes |  |
| `point_area_m2` | float \| None | no |  |
| `dirt` | list[list[any]] | no |  |
| `clutter` | list[list[any]] | no |  |
| `retrieved_at` | datetime | yes |  |

## `list_missions`

List the missions recorded in local history, newest first: robot, start and end, outcome, rooms requested (empty means the whole home), who started it, duration and errors. History is kept indefinitely and includes the mission in progress.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/missions` |
| MCP | tool `list_missions` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit missions list [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str \| None | no | null | Only this robot's missions (ID or unambiguous name). A removed robot's missions are still found by its ID. |
| `since` | datetime \| None | no | null | Only missions started at or after this time (ISO 8601; UTC if no offset) |
| `until` | datetime \| None | no | null | Only missions started before this time (ISO 8601; UTC if no offset) |
| `outcome` | MissionOutcome \| None | no | null | Only missions with this outcome |
| `limit` | int | no | 50 | Most missions to return |

**Result**

Type: `list[Mission]`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | str | yes |  |
| `robot_id` | str | yes |  |
| `started_at` | datetime | yes |  |
| `ended_at` | datetime \| None | no |  |
| `initiator` | Initiator | yes |  |
| `rooms_requested` | list[str] | no | Empty = whole home |
| `outcome` | MissionOutcome | no |  |
| `duration_s` | int \| None | no |  |
| `errors` | list[CodeText] | no |  |
| `cloud_mission_ref` | str \| None | no |  |

## `list_robots`

List every configured robot: ID, name, model, SKU, firmware, address, connection state and capabilities with their verification status. Robots without a model profile are listed with `supported=false` (see docs/guides/adding-a-model.md).

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/robots` |
| MCP | tool `list_robots` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit robots list [OPTIONS]` |

**Parameters**

_No fields._

**Result**

Type: `list[Robot]`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | str | yes | The robot's permanent ID (BLID); the only identifier. |
| `name` | str | yes |  |
| `profile_id` | str \| None | yes |  |
| `supported` | bool | yes |  |
| `sku` | str | yes |  |
| `firmware` | str | yes |  |
| `address` | str | yes |  |
| `connection` | ConnectionState | yes |  |
| `capabilities` | list[CapabilityStatus] | yes |  |

## `list_rooms`

List the robot's rooms: imported from the cloud, named locally, or learned from room cleans the robot reported (including ones started by other apps). Works without the cloud. Unnamed rooms are shown as `Room <id>`.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/robots/{robot}/rooms` |
| MCP | tool `list_rooms` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit rooms list [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or unambiguous name |

**Result**

Type: `RoomList`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `map` | MapRef \| None | yes | The robot's current map (the newest stored one while it hasn't reported state); null when nothing is known about its map. |
| `rooms` | list[Room] | yes | Rooms on that map: imported, locally named and learned. Rooms stored for an older map version are included with their own `map_version`. |
| `stale` | bool | yes | True when some rooms are for an older map: using them fails with `map_changed` until rooms are re-imported or named again. |
| `retrieved_at` | datetime \| None | no | When this map's rooms were last imported from the cloud. |

## `mission_wait`

Wait until a robot's mission ends and return it with its outcome. Without `mission_id` it waits for the current mission, or the next one if none is running. Returns `{timeout: true, mission}` if it hasn't ended in time.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `GET /v1/robots/{robot}/missions/wait` |
| MCP | tool `mission_wait` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit missions wait [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or unambiguous name |
| `mission_id` | str \| None | no | null | The mission to wait for; omit for the current or next mission |
| `timeout_s` | float | no | 1800 | Seconds to wait for the mission to end |

**Result**

Type: `Mission | MissionWaitTimeout`


## `name_room`

Give a room on the robot's current map a local name. Works without the cloud, for imported and learned rooms alike. Names apply to one map version.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `PUT /v1/robots/{robot}/rooms/{room_id}` |
| MCP | tool `name_room` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit rooms name [OPTIONS] ROBOT ROOM_ID NAME` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or unambiguous name |
| `room_id` | str | yes |  | The room's ID on the robot's current map |
| `name` | str | yes |  | The local name. Unique per map, ignoring case; it overrides the cloud name. |

**Result**

Type: `Room`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `robot_id` | str | yes |  |
| `map_id` | str | yes |  |
| `map_version` | str | yes |  |
| `room_id` | str | yes |  |
| `cloud_name` | str \| None | no |  |
| `local_name` | str \| None | no |  |
| `type` | str \| None | no |  |
| `name` | str | yes | Effective name: `local_name`, then `cloud_name`, then `Room <id>`. |

## `retrieve_password`

Retrieve the robot's local password over the network while you hold HOME on the docked robot, verify it by connecting, and store it. The password is never returned.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `POST /v1/robots/{robot}/password/retrieve` |
| MCP | tool `retrieve_password` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit robots password [OPTIONS] ROBOT` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or unambiguous name |
| `timeout_s` | float | no | 60.0 | How long to keep retrying (every 2 s) |

**Result**

Type: `PasswordRetrieval`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | "stored" \| "timeout" \| "cloud_only" | yes | `stored`: retrieved, verified and saved. `timeout`: the robot never answered. `cloud_only`: it answered but didn't release a password; retry with HOME held, or use `cloud_retrieve_password`. |
| `steps` | list[str] | yes | What to do at the robot |

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or unambiguous name |

| `outcome` | "stored" \| "auth_failed" | yes |  |

## `set_setting`

Change one setting. It is reported applied only once the robot reports the new value; otherwise the error is `not_applied` with the value the robot holds.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `PUT /v1/robots/{robot}/settings/{setting}` |
| MCP | tool `set_setting` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit settings set [OPTIONS] ROBOT SETTING VALUE` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or name |
| `setting` | str | yes |  | Setting name: passes, edge_clean, always_finish, child_lock, eco_charge, schedule_hold, pad_wetness or spray_overlap |
| `value` | bool \| int \| str | yes |  | passes: auto\|one\|two. edge_clean, always_finish, child_lock, eco_charge, schedule_hold: true\|false. pad_wetness: 1\|2\|3. spray_overlap: standard\|deep\|extended. |

**Result**

Type: `SettingChange`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `robot_id` | str | yes |  |
| `setting` | str | yes |  |
| `requested` | any | yes |  |
| `outcome` | "applied" \| "not_applied" | yes |  |
| `actual` | any | yes |  |

## `verify`

Check capabilities against the real robot and record the run: settings are written, read back and restored; commands are issued and confirmed (only `find` without allow_motion). Returns each result with evidence, plus a markdown report for `docs/verification/<profile>.md`.
⚠ Moves the robot: it will physically start, stop or drive.

| Surface | Usage |
|---|---|
| HTTP | `POST /v1/robots/{robot}/verify` |
| MCP | tool `verify` |
| CLI | `roomba-kit verify [OPTIONS] ROBOT [CAPABILITIES]...` |

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | str | yes |  | Robot ID or name |
| `capabilities` | list[str] \| None | no | null | Capabilities to check, e.g. `setting.passes find`. Default: every one the model declares (`train` is only ever run when named here) |
| `allow_motion` | bool | no | false | Run checks that act on the robot (every command except `find`). Without it they are skipped |

**Result**

Type: `VerificationRun`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | int | yes |  |
| `robot_id` | str | yes |  |
| `profile_id` | str | yes |  |
| `anchor` | str | yes | Stable anchor of this run in `docs/verification/<profile_id>.md`. A profile cites it as `verified(run='docs/verification/<profile_id>.md#<anchor>')` |
| `started_at` | datetime | yes |  |
| `ended_at` | datetime | yes |  |
| `allow_motion` | bool | yes |  |
| `results` | list[CheckResult] | yes |  |
| `report` | str | yes | The run as markdown, for `docs/verification/<profile_id>.md` |
